title: Microphone entry does not appear in list of entries in System Tray settings unless it is already shown
line: The microphone indicator is now always listed in System Tray Settings, so it can be set to "Always show" or hidden even while no app is recording.
explanation: The microphone indicator was a status notifier item that plasma-pa created only while an app was recording and deleted as soon as recording stopped. System Tray Settings lists plasmoids and the status notifier items that exist right now, so the Microphone entry, and any visibility chosen for it, vanished together with the icon. The change turns the indicator into a small tray widget (org.kde.plasma.microphoneindicator, "Microphone Indicator") following the Camera Indicator and Keyboard Layout patterns: it is Active while an app records and Hidden otherwise, so it is always listed in the settings and "Always show" keeps it in the tray; click/middle-click mute, wheel volume with OSD, the Mute menu action, icon and tooltip work as before.

commits.message:
microphoneindicator: turn the microphone indicator into a tray widget

The indicator was a status notifier item that existed only while an app
was recording, so System Tray Settings couldn't list it otherwise. It is
now a widget that stays hidden while idle, like the Camera Indicator.

BUG: 447123

media.caption: Before: nothing recording, searching "micro" in System Tray Settings > Entries finds nothing
After: nothing recording, "Microphone Indicator" is listed with all visibility options
Before: the entry only appears while an app records, and disappears with the icon
After: set to "Always show", the microphone icon stays in the tray while idle (click mutes, wheel changes volume)

review.text: Converting the microphone indicator from an ephemeral StatusNotifierItem into a tray plasmoid (`org.kde.plasma.microphoneindicator`) with Active/Hidden status is the right Plasma architecture and cleanly solves both 447123 and duplicate 462426. However, `microphoneindicator/main.qml` has several integration issues around activation, sizing outside the tray, and tooltip layering, plus leftover StatusNotifierItem CMake references.
changes: Connect `Plasmoid.activated` (e.g. via `Connections { target: Plasmoid; function onActivated() { MicrophoneIndicator.toggleMuted() } }`) in `microphoneindicator/main.qml` so keyboard activation in the System Tray, clicking the label in the hidden-icons popup, and the newly exposed global shortcut in System Tray Settings actually toggle mute.

Avoid `preferredRepresentation: fullRepresentation` with an unsized `MouseArea`: use `compactRepresentation` with proper `implicitWidth`/`implicitHeight` (or `Layout.minimumWidth`/`Layout.minimumHeight`) and prevent opening a popup on click (or set `"NoDisplay": true` in `metadata.json` if it is meant solely for System Tray), so it neither collapses to 0x0 on a standalone panel/desktop nor tries to expand when clicked from the System Tray's hidden-icons popup.

Remove the redundant `PlasmaCore.ToolTipArea` stacked over `MouseArea` in `microphoneindicator/main.qml`, since `PlasmoidItem` and System Tray already display tooltips from `toolTipMainText`/`toolTipSubText` and an overlaid `ToolTipArea` interferes with `parent.containsMouse` hover feedback on `Kirigami.Icon`.

Remove the unused `KF6::StatusNotifierItem` linkage from `plasma-volume` in `src/CMakeLists.txt` and `StatusNotifierItem` from `find_package(KF6 ...)` in the root `CMakeLists.txt` if nothing else in `plasma-pa` uses it.
